name: Simba Sea Trips
tagline: The original early-bird Phi Phi speedboat tour
taglineZh: 皮皮岛早鸟快艇一日游的开创者
description: Simba Sea Trips pioneered the 'early bird' strategy to beat the crowds at Phi Phi and Maya Bay. Small groups depart before 8am by speedboat with an English/Chinese-speaking crew, snorkelling gear and a delicious onboard lunch included.
descriptionZh: Simba Sea Trips 首创「早鸟」行程，赶在人潮前抵达皮皮岛与玛雅湾。快艇小团 8 点前出发，配中英文船员、浮潜装备与船上美味午餐。

services.name: Phang Nga Bay Early Bird Tour

location.address: Ao Po Grand Marina, 88/1 Moo 4, Pa Klok, Thalang, Phuket 83110

name: John Gray's Hong by Starlight
nameZh: 约翰·格雷星光海上皮划艇
tagline: Sea cave kayaking in Phang Nga Bay, ending under the stars
taglineZh: 攀牙湾海蚀洞皮划艇，星光下的难忘一天
description: John Gray's Sea Canoe is the legendary Phang Nga Bay eco-tour. Paddle inflatable sea kayaks through hidden hongs (collapsed cave lagoons), then return after dark to float handmade Loy Krathong candle boats under the stars.
descriptionZh: John Gray 海上皮划艇是攀牙湾传奇生态之旅。划着双人充气皮划艇穿行隐秘的「Hong」塌陷洞湖，夜幕降临后在水面上放自制水灯，星光与萤火相伴。

location.address: Ao Po Grand Marina, Pa Klok, Thalang, Phuket 83110

name: Sea Cave Canoe
nameZh: 海上溶洞皮划艇·攀牙湾
tagline: Classic Phang Nga Bay canoe and James Bond Island day trip
taglineZh: 攀牙湾经典皮划艇与詹姆士邦德岛一日游
description: Sea Cave Canoe runs the classic Phang Nga Bay day trip: sightseeing past James Bond Island, canoeing through limestone sea caves into hidden lagoons, plus a scenic sunset return cruise with fresh fruit and Thai snacks.
descriptionZh: Sea Cave Canoe 运营攀牙湾经典一日游：游览詹姆士邦德岛，划皮划艇穿越石灰岩海蚀洞进入隐秘礁湖，日落时分伴着水果与泰式点心乘船返程。

services.name: Phang Nga Bay Canoe Day Trip

location.address: Ao Po Grand Marina, Pa Klok, Thalang, Phuket 83110
